eval-bot: :rotating_light: nightly-eval run 2026-03-20 06:05 UTC: 3 suites FAILED (convo-coherence, long-context, safety-instruction). Aggregate drop vs baseline >= 6% on several cohorts. Severity: P2. Filing thread for triage.
maria: ugh — seeing multiple failures that span coherence + safety. tagging @anya @zhao for owners. any recent infra or model changes? :eyes:
leo: I merged the token normalization tweak to tokenizer yesterday (~commit 7a2f9b). It touched BPE merges and whitespace handling but should be minor. no quant changes in model build.
anya: grabbing logs. which model/variant did the job run against?
eval-bot: Model: redwood-v2a-int4-20260319 (quantized build, kernel v2). Job id: nightly-20260320-03. Full job link: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightly/20260320-03
santosh: I see a spike in OOV rate in the eval logs starting at sample 1420 for convo-coherence. Token distribution shifted — subtoken counts up ~8% vs baseline.
maria: that points at tokenizer change + quant compounding. @zhao can you confirm int4 run artifacts? maybe KV cache misalignment?
zhao: pulling artifacts now. quick check: logits look reasonable but top-1 token mass shifts on punctuation-heavy prompts. suspicious. trying a repro run locally.
anya: I'll run targeted promptset subsets (safety-instruction + convo-coherence) through the prior tokenizer version + current tokenizer to compare diffs.
maria: owner plan: anya -> promptset/labeling triage, zhao -> model/quant artifact repro, santosh -> token-distribution diff + minimal reproducer. I'll hold the rollout of redwood-v2a-int4 until we have a root-cause.
leo: thumbs up. small repro command for anyone testing locally:
```
./scripts/run_eval.py --suite convo-coherence,safety-instruction --model redwood-v2a-int4-20260319 --batch 16 --seed 42 --out /tmp/repro
```
please also test with `--tokenizer v1.3.4-old` to compare.
santosh: running tokenizer diff now. early result: input "Mr. O'Neil" tokenized differently (split vs combined) which explains some safety prompt completions diverging. saving diffs.
zhao: local repro done. with previous tokenizer + same quant build, metrics match baseline. with new tokenizer we see the coherence drop. quant alone doesn't reproduce.
anya: labeling note: some prompts now bias toward shorter responses on the new tokenization because certain stop-token merges changed. safety checks tripping more often.
maria: immediate next steps: 1) roll back tokenizer tweak in nightly branch (leo), 2) run full-nightly with old tokenizer + current quant (zhao), 3) gather labeled diffs and sample set (anya + santosh). aim to have results within 4 hours.
leo: rolling back now. created PR to revert commit 7a2f9b, CI running.
zhao: kicking off quick-run against nightly infra with reverted tokenizer. job id: quick-2834567940. will post results here.
eval-bot: quick-2834567940 completed: convo-coherence PASS, long-context PASS, safety-instruction PASS. metrics within tolerance.
maria: excellent — initial evidence points to tokenizer tweak as primary regression vector. keep this thread updated when full nightly finishes. thanks y'all. :tada:
anya: collecting samples for postmortem and will prepare a minimal test-case to add to the eval suite to catch this tokenization drift.
santosh: adding a regression test that asserts tokenization stability for a small curated anchor set. will PR today.
leo: re-deploy of tokenizer patch blocked until we add the regression test. :lock:
maria: assigning owners in tracker: ENG-ML-9123 root-cause = tokenizer-change; owners: anya, zhao, santosh. severity P2 -> will escalate to P1 only if rollback doesn't stabilize production or if more suites flip.
anya: noted. I'll create the ticket with sample traces and annotated diffs.
zhao: will paste artifact links here once upload completes.
eval-bot: artifacts uploaded: https://artifacts.internal/redwood/nightly/2834567890/diffs.tar.gz
maria: closing initial triage. we'll reconvene if new failures appear. :white_check_mark:
